Container.Name: EasyPhotos
Container.Overview: Lightweight self-hosted photo gallery. Reads your existing photo folders, makes small thumbnails, finds and groups faces (same AI models as Immich), map, calendar, tags, albums, duplicate finder, Recycle Bin, users with roles, and an API for random photos. One container: no separate database needed.

Config.Name: Appdata (database, settings)
Config.Description: Small. Holds the encrypted database and backups.

Config.Name: Thumbnails
Config.Description: The biggest folder EasyPhotos makes. Point it at a share on your array, not appdata.

Config.Name: Photo library 1
Config.Description: Your photos. Use rw to allow deleting to the Recycle Bin, or ro for read-only. Add more paths as /libraries/something-else.

Config.Name: Database encryption key
Config.Description: Any long random password. Set it before the FIRST start and never change it, or the database can't be opened.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for video dates and the overnight speed boost.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users)
